title: A warm home after a familiar ending

captions.energy: Preserving the former picture of happiness

meaning: Domestic care sustains you through change when it is not expected immediately to restore the happiness of a routine that has ended.
text: Home can stay warm even when a familiar part of shared life comes to an end. The Empress in the physical position of Muladhara helps you continue caring for daily comfort: cooking, making space liveable and preserving pleasant details. The Sun in energy tests your footing through wanting to retain the former bright picture at any cost. Death in emotions experiences the ending of an old domestic form that no longer exists as before. You can appreciate present care while grieving a familiar routine; neither feeling has to cancel the other for peace at home.

Imagine replacing an old chair in your favourite reading corner. The new one is more comfortable, with a lamp thoughtfully placed nearby, yet the familiar feeling is missing. **The warmth of home today need not forget what has ended.** New comforts can settle gradually. When change is allowed to be visible, care stops competing with memory and can support you where you actually live together now.

The difficulty is treating sadness as evidence that your efforts are insufficient. You want to brighten the evening, restore joy more insistently and replace the former feeling quickly. Yet the new arrangement starts to sound like a demand to stop feeling loss. Support grows steadier when the ending can be felt alongside simple domestic tasks, without care having to repair the mood and restore the old picture immediately.
